text: Input History 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的输入历史插件：在聊天编辑框中用方向键回看已发送的用户消息，也可通过时钟按钮打开历史面板。它把浮动列表和按钮分别接入 conversation.input.overlay 与 conversation.input.right，从当前会话快照读取用户及 steering 消息。面板按日期分组并显示时间，支持键盘浏览、点击选中、确认或取消恢复草稿，并限制为最近 500 条、合并连续重复项。适合经常重复输入、需要找回上一条提示的 Web 用户；无需额外配置。

Input History adds message recall to the DSH Web composer. Use arrow keys or a clock button to browse current session messages in a floating list grouped by date. Select an entry to restore its text, or cancel to recover your draft. It collapses consecutive duplicates and keeps up to 500 entries.
想在聊天框里用方向键找回刚才发过的消息。

让网页聊天编辑框显示一个可点击的输入历史列表。
输入框里误删了草稿，能否从已发送内容里恢复？

Add a small history button beside the composer so I can reuse an old message.
Input History 的功能「方向键回溯」：在聊天编辑框光标位于开头时按上键回到最近消息，位于末尾按下键从较早消息开始；继续用方向键浏览并用 Enter 接受。
Input History 的功能「历史浮层浏览」：编辑框历史浮层按日期分组并显示消息时间，长内容以多行预览呈现；点击某条即可将完整消息放回编辑框。
Input History 的功能「时钟按钮打开」：点击编辑框工具行的时钟按钮打开历史面板并载入最近一条消息；没有历史时按钮禁用。
Input History 的功能「草稿取消与恢复」：打开历史时保存当前草稿；按 Esc 或点击面板外取消会恢复草稿，向前越过最新记录也会关闭面板并恢复。
Input History 的功能「历史列表整理」：历史从当前会话的用户和 steering 消息读取，跳过空白内容，合并连续重复消息并只保留最新 500 条。
Input History 从当前会话快照读取消息，列表最多保留 500 条且连续重复内容会合并；代码未实现持久化存储。

@wellorbetter/dsh-input-history README · Introduction：

Arrow-key input history for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
Press ↑ / ↓ in the chat composer to walk back and forth through what you already sent — with a floating history dropdown.

Demo screenshot with sample data — message content is blurred.

@wellorbetter/dsh-input-history README · What this plugin provides：Installing this bundle adds one **client (browser) plugin** to every session of the target dsh profile. It registers a floating history dropdown above the composer (`conversation.input.overlay`) and a clock **history button** in the composer's tool row (`conversation.input.right`):

@wellorbetter/dsh-input-history README · What this plugin provides：- **↑ recalls the previous message** when the caret is at the very start of the input (an empty input qualifies); **↓ steps forward**, and past the newest entry restores the draft you were typing.
- **Enter accepts**, **Esc / click-outside cancels** (restores the pre-recall draft), and **clicking a row** jumps straight to that message.
- **Date grouping** (today / yesterday / earlier) plus **per-row timestamps** keep long histories scannable.
- **Long messages** render as a 3-line clamped preview with the full text on hover (`title`), and recall puts the complete multi-line text back into the composer.
- Consecutive duplicate messages are collapsed, and the list is capped at the latest 500 entries.

@wellorbetter/dsh-input-history README · What this plugin provides：The plugin is pure client UI — no host-side behavior, no persistence, no network. The history is read live from the session's conversation snapshot, so it is always scoped to the session you are looking at.

@wellorbetter/dsh-input-history README · How it behaves：```text
composer caret ──↑ at start ──▶ open history (most recent)
        ▲                       │
        │                       ├── ↑  older
        │                       ├── ↓  newer  ── past newest ──▶ restore saved draft, close

@wellorbetter/dsh-input-history README · How it behaves：Recall never fights the slash (`/`) or mention (`@`) menus: when the trigger menu is open, its own up/down arbitration owns the arrows. Modified chords (Ctrl/Cmd/Alt) and IME composition pass through untouched, and multi-line editing is unaffected until the caret reaches a boundary.

@wellorbetter/dsh-input-history README · Install：Requires the `dsh` CLI ([install DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)).

```sh
@wellorbetter/dsh-input-history README · from GitHub (recommended)：dsh plugin --profile web add github:wellorbetter/dsh-input-history

@wellorbetter/dsh-input-history README · or from a local checkout：Restart the profile (`dsh web` / `dsh --profile <name>`) after installing. The plugin is a [bundle](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md): it declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin` reconciles it into the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` layer list automatically, and `dsh.client` so the web shell loads its browser half. It ships plain JavaScript (`lib/index.js` + `lib/client.js`), so a GitHub install needs no build step or `allowBuilds` permission.

@wellorbetter/dsh-input-history README · Use：Focus the chat composer in any session and press <kbd>↑</kbd> at the start of the input (or <kbd>↓</kbd> at the end) to open the history dropdown, then navigate with the arrows and press <kbd>Enter</kbd> to accept, or click a row to jump to it. You can also click the clock button in the composer's tool row to open the same panel.

@wellorbetter/dsh-input-history README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm verify     # asserts the host half, the client bundle, and the patch manifest
```
